response.justification: While Szabo demonstrates strong technical leadership, successful product shipping, and mentorship capabilities across multiple roles, he fails to meet critical minimum qualifications for this position. Most significantly, he lacks the required 8 years of C++ programming experience—the resume shows approximately 6 months of C++ work at National Instruments in 2014-2015, with C++ not even listed in his core skills. His career has focused primarily on web/full-stack development rather than systems programming or cloud compute infrastructure. Although he has some infrastructure experience with Docker and Kubernetes, this does not compensate for the fundamental gap in the required technical foundation.
strengths: Proven track record leading and mentoring engineers with multiple Staff/Senior-level roles, plus organized code dojos and created educational workshops demonstrating strong mentorship orientation

Extensive experience shipping production software across diverse domains (web, mobile, embedded), including a top-10 ranked Apple TV app and multi-country platform supporting millions of mail requests
Demonstrated DevOps and infrastructure capability including Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and low-latency microservices handling millions of requests per second
concerns: Severely lacks the minimum required C++ experience (8 years required; less than 1 year documented in 2014-2015)
Career trajectory is primarily in web and full-stack development rather than systems programming or cloud compute platform engineering
No advanced degree and limited documented evidence of technical leadership specifically within cloud or DevOps engineering teams

key_factors.factor: General technical leadership and mentorship capability
